title: finding(plugin-view): ObjectView's non-grid bus re-read subscribes for view types nothing renders, and flashes the calendar's loading placeholder on every re-read
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the close of objectui#10887. These are review notes (b) and (c) from the members 1–2 round (release `5864212493`, contract review of PR objectui#10898). Both need a behaviour change, so they were left out of member 3 (PR objectui#10973), and the at-tier review `5870012015` confirmed both true. Without this card they would live only in a merged PR's Acceptance notes. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## (b) The re-read subscribes for view types nothing renders

`ObjectView`'s `fetchDrawsView` (in `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`) is a deny-list: grid, tree and chart. A view type that `generateViewSchema` has no case for still subscribes to the data-invalidation bus and re-reads once per matching event, for rows nothing renders. `generateViewSchema` returns `null`, and `renderContent` falls through to `ObjectGrid`, which queries for itself. The cost is a wasted request per bus event on such a view. An allow-list of the view types whose renderer draws the fetched rows would remove it.

## (c) The calendar flashes its loading placeholder on every bus re-read

`ObjectView`'s non-grid fetch calls `setLoading(true)` at the start of every run, bus re-reads included, and passes `loading` to the view. `ObjectCalendar` with host rows mirrors that and swaps to its "Loading calendar…" placeholder, the same flash as its own reader had under objectui#10572. A re-read that keeps the current rows on screen until the new ones arrive, as the first load need not, would remove it.

## Pins a taker would add
- (b): a view type with no schema case does not re-read on a bus event.
- (c): a calendar with host rows keeps its events rendered across a bus re-read.

The existing lit controls stay green in both: a first load still shows the placeholder, and an event on another object still does not re-read.

Dedupe words: ObjectView fetchDrawsView deny-list, non-grid bus re-read loading flash, calendar placeholder re-read, objectui#10887 notes b c.
